_about: What locals know: notes a newcomer only finds out by trying, written by hand for one country at a time and never templated across countries. A country with no notes shows nothing. Each note is a label of at most seven words over one fact of at most 140 characters; at most five notes a country.

GB.label: Small premises often pay less
GB.fact: In England, a shop with a rateable value of £12,000 or less pays no business rates.
GB.source: Small Business Rate Relief, England 2026-27: 100% at a rateable value of £12,000 or less (research 2026-09-25, item 22)

GB.label: The first hire triggers a pension
GB.fact: A first employee earning over £10,000 a year means pension auto-enrolment: budget for it from the first payslip.
GB.source: data/sections/rules.json pension-trigger: earnings that require auto-enrolment, 2026-27, checked 2026-10-04
